description.text:
The first set of the EX series and the first published by Pokémon USA, which took the English game over from Wizards of the Coast. Released on 18 June 2003 with 109 cards and two theme decks, Ruby and Sapphire, it brought in the third generation of Pokémon from the Game Boy Advance games it is named after, more than 40 of them new to the game, among them Treecko, Torchic and Mudkip.

It introduced Pokémon-ex, stronger Pokémon with high HP that give up two Prize cards instead of one when Knocked Out; the EX of the series' name stands for the extra power they brought. The cards took on the layout of the Japanese cards, and the e-Reader dot code shrank to a single strip along the bottom, which shows where to find the Pokémon in the video games. The set also brought in two-on-two battles, in which each player fights with two Pokémon at once.
